evidence.exceptions: recognition: too-short narrative refused with readable reason (recognition.test.ts checkRecognitionReview validates narrative.trim().length >= 20), coaching without note refused (coaching_note required when review_state is 'coached'), self-review refused (RLS + checkRecognitionReview blocks authored_by_staff_id === reviewed_by_staff_id), double-review refused (review_state already coached/dismissed denies subsequent update); closeout: promises and what_worked notes required (upsertShiftCloseout enforces both), extra_mile_act_id optional foreign-key validated to same retailer/staff before insert
evidence.browser: apps/retailer/e2e/staff-recognition.spec.ts (too-short narrative refused, act logs and appears in queue, coaching without note refused, coaching with note succeeds and moves to reviewed list, no leaderboard language on page, double-review prevented); apps/retailer/e2e/staff-closeout.spec.ts (closeout submitted, persists on revisit, manager sees it); apps/retailer/e2e/staff-today.spec.ts (staff sees unified role home, completed closeout shows instead of prompt, staff can complete their own assigned customer opportunity)
evidence.live_gap: No external provider dependency — this item is entirely first-party domain/RLS/UI work with no live-credential gap.
